name: Stage 56: Trosa to Tullgarns slott
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 56, Trosa to Tullgarns slott.
utilities: Official area: Södertäljes kommun, Trosa kommun.

Trosa has the strongest start services: buses, town parking, public toilets, potable town water, food, lodging, and resupply. There is no parking at the stage board itself; use town parking such as Högbergsgatan/Trosa kyrka areas and check local time limits.

Trosa tourist information, harbour services, and town lodging/food options sit close enough to the start to be useful for planning. Public toilets are available in town/harbour locations, with some year-round and some seasonal; verify current municipal status before relying on a specific toilet.

Stensund is the key mid-stage service point, with seasonal harbour tap, summer toilets, bathing, parking, grill/rest area, and folkhögskola/servering services when open. It is also a sensible bail-in/bail-out point if 20 km is too much.
Anderviken is the main on-stage shelter/rest facility after about 12 km. It has a shelter plus third-party/blog-confirmed toilet/fire/table context, but no reliable drinking water and no sea view.

Tullgarn stage endpoint is near the Tullgarn/Kungsgård stage junction; palace toilets, cafe/restaurant, parking, Orangeriet summer restaurant, and visitor services are a short detour from the exact route endpoint and are seasonal/opening-hour dependent.
waterSources: Stensund is the only dependable on-route refill, but seasonal: official guidance says the harbour tap is open from 1 May to the end of September behind the outhouse/toilet at Stensunds hamn.
Outside the Stensund tap season, water may be possible at Stensunds servering/restaurant when open, but this is not an all-hours guarantee.
Trosa has town water through public services and taps; Tullgarn has visitor services when open. Komötet and coastal water are bathing/natural water only, not potable refill points.
No reliable drinking water was verified at Anderviken shelter; carry from Stensund/Trosa or plan around Tullgarn services.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden, Naturkartan, and OSM relation 7449018 list Stage 56 as 20.0 km. Third-party tracks vary from about 19.4-22.4 km depending on access, direction, endpoint, and optional variants; use 20 km as canonical.

Stage 56 connects cleanly to Stage 55 at Trosa and to Stage 57 at Tullgarn. OSM relation 7449018 is continuous internally and measured about 19.47 km in the geometry review; the Stage 56 OSM endpoint is about 78 m from the Stage 57 start marker, a palace-area endpoint-placement mismatch rather than a real hiking gap.

Long, moderate stage with mixed urban streets, country roads, coastal paths, forest paths, rocky slabs, hilly/kuperad sections, open land, and final Tullgarn road approach. Expect slower going than a flat 20 km and be careful on wet rock slabs.

Road-walking warning: the route uses town streets, country roads, and final approach roads. Walk on pavement/shoulder where present, use the left side when forced onto the roadway, and use reflectors or a lamp in low light.

Navigation warning from official/Naturkartan and hiker sources: follow Sörmlandsleden's orange S-markings on trees/posts/arrows, not other similar orange/square/hip-height exercise-route markings in the Stensund/Tullgarn area. Older downloaded GPX/screenshots can also be slightly wrong near Tullgarn.
Stensund camping is not a normal drop-in public hiker campsite; Stensund describes camping as group/seasonal arrangements. Do not plan ordinary tent camping there without direct permission/booking.

Komötet/Komöte badplats is a day-use bathing place with toilets/changing, not a confirmed legal campsite. Older trip reports and older route/package language conflict around camping/fire here; current signs and reserve rules win.

Tullgarn/Furholmen reserve rules are stricter than general allemansrätten: dogs/pets leashed, fires only at prepared places, camping forbidden in Furholmen and the inner/original Tullgarn reserve zone, and no collecting/breaking wood in Furholmen.
Stensund reserve also has special rules protecting plants, deadwood, fungi/lichens, and invertebrate habitats; organized camps/competitions require permission.

Tullgarn transit is limited and timetable-sensitive. Trosabussen's winter timetable checked for 2025-12-15 to 2026-06-14 shows Tullgarn service only in limited/requested weekend contexts; verify same-day routing.

Official Stage 56 page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass. Fire-ban map checks found no general fire ban for Trosa/Södertälje at that time, but fire-risk notices are dynamic and protected-area prepared-fireplace rules still apply.

Tullgarn palace park is generally open year-round, while palace interiors/cafe/restaurant services are seasonal/opening-hour dependent. Palace visitor rules restrict pets indoors, large bags, spikes, drones, and disruptive photography.

facilities.description: Tourist information/map context near the start, with seasonal address/opening variations. Useful for planning support, not a trail facility.

facilities.name: Trosa kyrka parking
facilities.description: Officially suggested church/churchyard-area parking alternative for the Trosa start. Check local signs and church/cemetery access.

facilities.name: Coop Trosa
facilities.description: Central supermarket/resupply option near the stage start. Opening hours vary.

facilities.name: ICA Trossen
facilities.description: Larger north-Trosa supermarket/resupply option, useful before starting or after bus/train access. Opening hours vary.

facilities.name: Trosa public toilet
facilities.description: Town public toilet context near the Trosa start/services. Opening hours vary by location.

facilities.name: Trosa Busstorget public toilet
facilities.description: Municipal/OSM public-toilet context near Busstorget and the central bus/parking area. Verify current municipal status and hours.

facilities.name: Trosa town drinking water
facilities.description: Town tap/service water context near central Trosa. Verify exact access and opening hours.

facilities.name: Trosa harbour drinking-water point
facilities.description: OSM-mapped harbour/waterfront drinking-water point. Verify seasonality locally before relying on it.

facilities.name: Stensundsvägen bus access
facilities.description: Bus access mentioned by Sörmlandsleden for joining/leaving the route; follow the trail from the stop and verify live service.

facilities.name: Stensund parking
facilities.description: Parking by Stensund/Stensunds folkhögskola area, useful for shortening the stage. Check local signs.

facilities.name: Stensund accessible parking
facilities.description: Länsstyrelsen notes visitor parking at Stensunds folkhögskola and a centrally placed accessible parking space in the area. Full Stage 56 is not accessibility-adapted overall.

facilities.name: Stensund seasonal harbour tap
facilities.description: Official seasonal refill: tap behind the outhouse/toilet at Stensunds hamn, normally 1 May to the end of September. Verify season and operation.

facilities.name: Stensund summer toilets
facilities.description: Summer toilets at Stensund according to official stage notes. Seasonal; do not rely on them outside summer.

facilities.name: Stensund folkhögskola/servering
facilities.description: Opening-hour-dependent lunch/servering service. Official notes say water may be filled at the serving outside tap season if open.

facilities.name: Stensund grill/rest area
facilities.description: Official rest/grill area behind the dance floor with tables, benches, and bin. Fire bans and local rules still apply.

facilities.name: Stensund bathing/harbour area
facilities.description: Bathing from beach/jetties near the Stensund harbour area. Not potable water.

facilities.name: Stensund camping caveat
facilities.description: Stensund camping is not normal drop-in hiker camping; public pages describe group/seasonal arrangements. Book/ask directly before planning to tent there.

facilities.name: Anderviken shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter/rest point after about 12 km. Shared, first-come, not bookable, dry/no reliable water nearby, and described by hikers as functional forest shelter rather than a sea-view camp.

facilities.name: Anderviken fireplace/grill
facilities.description: Third-party shelter maps report fireplace/grill at Anderviken; use only if current fire bans and local rules allow.

facilities.name: Anderviken mapped privy
facilities.description: Third-party shelter maps report a privy/toilet at Anderviken. Medium confidence; official stage page confirms shelter but not detailed amenities.

facilities.name: Anderviken no-water caveat
facilities.description: No reliable drinking-water source was verified at Anderviken shelter. Carry water from Stensund/Trosa or plan around Tullgarn services.

facilities.name: Old lime kiln before Komötet
facilities.description: Official route text mentions an old lime kiln before Komötet. Marker is approximate and should be field/GPS confirmed before using as a precision target.

facilities.name: Komötet / Komöte badplats
facilities.description: Municipal bathing place with shallow sandy/grass beach context, toilets/changing nearby, lifebuoy/info sign, and 2025 bathing-water classification listed as excellent for the 2026 season. Not a drinking-water source.

facilities.name: Komötet toilet/changing cabin
facilities.description: Bathing-place toilet/changing context. Trosa municipality lists temporary summer toilet modules at Komöte; seasonal/local conditions may vary.

facilities.name: Komötet no-camping/fire caveat
facilities.description: Treat Komötet as day-use bathing/rest only. Older route descriptions and hiker reports conflict around camping/fires, while reports also found no-tenting/no-fire signage; obey current local signs and reserve boundaries.

facilities.name: Furholmsberget / fornborg viewpoint spur
facilities.description: Optional viewpoint/fornborg loop/spur context mentioned in stage descriptions. Draw as optional nearby branch only, not the main stage line.

facilities.name: Pilskogsbergen viewpoint context
facilities.description: Officially described view over Tullgarnsviken and the palace area. Approximate route-derived marker; exact lookout point should be field confirmed.

facilities.name: Similar orange markings warning
facilities.description: Official and hiker reports warn that other orange markings occur near Stensund/Tullgarn. Follow Sörmlandsleden's orange S-markers, posts, and arrows only.

facilities.name: Wet rock and hilly-section warning
facilities.description: Hiker reports describe more hills than expected and slippery rock slabs after rain, especially around Furholmsberget/Pilskogsbergen/Tullgarn-side terrain.

facilities.name: Stage 56 road-walking safety
facilities.description: The stage includes town streets, country-road walking, and the final Tullgarn road approach. Use shoulders/pavements, walk left when on the roadway, and use reflectors or a lamp in low light.

facilities.name: Old Tullgarn GPX endpoint caveat
facilities.description: Official, Naturkartan, and OSM agree on the Tullgarn handoff area, but some older third-party GPX/downloads had a slightly wrong endpoint. Use current route data and local waymarks.

facilities.name: Tullgarn stage 56/57 junction
facilities.description: Stage 56 endpoint and stage 57 start area near Tullgarn/Kungsgård. Palace services are a short walk from the exact route endpoint.

facilities.name: Tullgarns slott
facilities.description: Palace/visitor attraction near the trail endpoint. Services are seasonal and not exactly at the stage board.

facilities.name: Tullgarn visitor parking
facilities.description: Visitor parking near palace services and toilets. Check local signs and seasonal arrangements.

facilities.name: Tullgarn visitor toilets
facilities.description: Free toilets by the visitor parking/palace service area, including wheelchair-accessible toilet context. Royal Palaces list daily hours around 09:00-16:30 Jun-Aug and 09:00-16:00 Sep-May; verify current opening.

facilities.name: Tullgarn cafe/shop
facilities.description: Seasonal cafe/shop/visitor-centre context in Drottning Victorias stall, with drinks, pastries/waffles, shop, and tour tickets when open; verify current opening days/hours before relying on food or water.

facilities.name: Tullgarns värdshus/restaurant
facilities.description: Restaurant/cafe context near Tullgarn, opening-hour and season dependent. Verify directly before planning resupply.

facilities.name: Orangeriet Tullgarn
facilities.description: Summertime restaurant/service context in the Tullgarn area. Seasonal; verify opening before relying on it.

facilities.name: Tullgarn limited bus access
facilities.description: Trosabussen/Tullgarn stop area is limited and timetable-sensitive. Checked 2025-12-15 to 2026-06-14 timetable shows weekend Tullgarn service, with riders needing to tell the driver from Liljeholmen and only selected Trosa departures via Tullgarn; verify same-day service.

facilities.name: Tullgarn/Furholmen reserve rules
facilities.description: Dogs/pets leashed, fires only at designated prepared places, camping forbidden in Furholmen and inner Tullgarn zones, no collecting/breaking wood in Furholmen, no motor vehicles except designated roads, no caravans/trailers set up, and riding only where allowed.

facilities.name: Tullgarn palace visitor rules
facilities.description: Park is generally year-round, but palace interior tours/services are seasonal. Indoors: pets generally not allowed except assistance dogs, large bags/strollers/spikes/drone/tripod/flash restrictions apply.

facilities.name: Tullgarn falling-spruce warning
facilities.description: Länsstyrelsen notes bark-beetle-damaged spruce/falling-tree risk in Tullgarn. Be cautious in wind and avoid lingering under dead spruces.
